## History

Walter was the father of [Anne](../character/anne.md), who died of fever alongside his wife, Bertha, when [Anne](../character/anne.md) was only three months old. His death left [Anne](../character/anne.md) an orphan, forcing her into a childhood of moving between families and caring for children before being sent to an asylum. Years later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visited Walter's former home in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) and his grave, where she received and read a packet of old love letters written between Walter and Bertha, finally allowing her to feel deeply connected to her parents.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V.
